title: When no ancestor declares documentation, every leaf's reported doc is exactly the doc it declared
rationale: The passing leg of the DECLARED_DOC comparator. Without it the comparator has only diverging fixtures and cannot be distinguished from a comparator that always diverges. It also states a real guarantee: isDocInherited is false and doc is verbatim when nothing was inherited.
catchesBugClass: docInherited being set for a leaf that declared its own doc - the flag is computed as field.doc()==null && fieldDoc!=null, which a refactor could easily invert - and a leaf's own doc being overwritten by an ancestor's.
cannotCatch: Nothing about inheritance, by construction, since no ancestor declares a doc. It also cannot see a record-level doc on the ROOT record, which the walk seeds separately.

predicted.detail: Both sides are keyed by source path and carry the same shape, so equality is meaningful rather than a shape mismatch that can never be equal.

configDescription: assert ENRICHED_METADATA vs DECLARED_DOC, default FlattenOptions
